description: Fine-tune salience dose-response on the FULL pair graph across all gap strata. For each pair (winner g, loser f) the study-recipe pair classifier is fine-tuned (2 seeds) and read out on loser f's graded dose texts (g at its absent pole). Commitment toward f = d = logit(' X')-logit(' Y'); dose level 0 = both absent. Metrics per stratum: mean shift level0->max and present->max (nats), and FLIP RATE at max text salience (fraction whose committed contest flips to f, mean d>0). Compared to the probe's per-stratum flip rates and to the prior 78-pair well-separated fine-tune run.

selection_rule: loser f is dose-able (one of 33 graded features). Binary-trigger losers have no gradient and are dropped automatically. All gap strata; below_floor_held pairs kept (as in the probe's all663 breakdown) so the prior 78 well-separated pairs are fully reused.

label_pole_mapping.flip_to_f: mean d over the max-salience dose texts > 0

probe_flip_metrics_explained.orth_flip_rate_activation_unbounded: probe: fraction flipped by amplifying the loser's activation ORTHOGONALLY, with NO cap on the amplification factor (median gain needed ~20x); an activation-space ceiling, NOT text-achievable.
probe_flip_metrics_explained.text_reachable_flips_le_1p5x: probe: flips achievable within the <=1.5x salience factor a real text can plausibly reach -- the fair analog of this run's TEXT dose sweep.

probe_baseline_text_reachable.note: probe commitment moved ~0.22 nats over the text-achievable (<=1.5x) salience range and flipped 1/663 contests within that range.

coverage_note: near_tie 60/60 and mid_gap 133/133 COMPLETE; well_separated 187/422 (systematic alphabetical subsample that includes the exact prior-78 well-separated pairs). The remaining well-separated jobs were not run: a mid-run GPU-contention spike on the shared Modal B200 pool doubled per-job wall-time (to ~213s) and the projected total tripped the $250 hard-cap guard, which stopped launching new jobs. The two scientifically novel strata (near-tie, mid-gap) and all safety strata are fully covered. Total spend $127.26, under the $180 target.
